blocks.title: Look Around You!
blocks.body: What shape is your screen? What shape is a pizza?

blocks.title: Basic Shapes
blocks.body:
Circle: Round, no corners.
Square: 4 equal sides.
Triangle: 3 sides.
Rectangle: 4 sides (2 long, 2 short).

blocks.question: A door is usually what shape?
blocks.explanation: Doors are tall and have 4 sides (Rectangle).

blocks.title: Counting Sides
blocks.body: To identify a shape, just count its straight sides and corners!

blocks.title: Shapes in Nature
blocks.body: The sun is a circle. Pine trees look like triangles!

blocks.question: If you put two squares side by side, what new shape do they make?
blocks.explanation: They make a rectangle because it becomes longer on one side!
